[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Lyne''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Dating Logic">{{TOR dates|2}} Lyne is present on the Republic version of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. As the events on Balmorra for all Republic classes occur in Act II, it can be inferred they take place in 3642 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. From this, it can be assumed Lyne was present on Balmorra in that year.</ref> she [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] items in [[Farnel Outpost]], the Republic's base on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] at that [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="TOR" />
